scenes.title: An Indoor Paint Shop
scenes.summary: On rainy Monday morning, Lukas sets up cross-breeze airflow in the wide back hallway so Klara and Werner can paint the four shutters indoors.

scenes.title: Green Glasses
scenes.summary: Martin insists on painting one shutter slat to help, immediately getting a streak of green paint on the reading glasses perched on his forehead.

scenes.title: Middle D Sings Again
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning, Werner reseats the tiny brass pin and tunes the middle strings while Helga tests middle D on the walnut piano.

scenes.title: Hanging the Green Shutters
scenes.summary: In Tuesday's bright afternoon sun, Werner, Lukas, and Klara hang the freshly painted green shutters around Room 9's arched glass.

scenes.title: The Welcome Sign
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Klara designs a simple welcome sign and café menu card that Martin and Helga check line by line.

scenes.title: Watch the Low Stool
scenes.summary: In the Tuesday evening kitchen, Miriam reaches for the big copper teapot on the high shelf and twists her right ankle stepping off the low wooden stool.

scenes.title: Ice, Pillows, and Orders
scenes.summary: Klara and Moritz prop Miriam's ankle comfortably on two pillows while Miriam writes out step-by-step Wednesday baking jobs for the whole crew.

scenes.title: One Jar Is Salt
scenes.summary: Late Tuesday night while tidying the counter for dawn baking, Martin refills two unlabeled white ceramic jars—leaving Klara and Werner unsure which is sugar and which is salt.
